title: UAC Invasion: The Supply Depot
description: UAC Invasion: The Supply Depot is a single-level map for Doom II set inside a large corporate facility where secret portal and Satanic experiments took place. Infiltrating the base hidden within a UAC truck, the player must explore the overrun complex. The level includes several new monsters, a large array of custom objects, and custom music by Andrew G. Sega.
